name: Ryoujoku Salesman ~Akutoku Shouhou Toranomaki~
original_name: 凌辱せぇるすまん～悪徳商法虎の巻～
source:
Main character gets experience at a trading company and then becomes a self-employed salesman. He gets excellent in skills to sell something even if it is not needed to the potential buyer. When confronting women, he uses their weaknesses and desires to come to a beneficial result.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一家贸易公司获得经验，然后成为一名个体营业员。即使潜在买家不需要，他也能以出色的技巧出售某些东西。当面对女性时，他利用她们的弱点和欲望来达到有利的结果。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
